Subject: MAP: Lockstep reserve lane — GPU sizing & lead-time alignment

Daphne / Helix procurement team —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As discussed, we want to put a short, actionable MAP in place that (1) secures the Dedicated/Private reservation lane you need for production; (2) synchronizes evaluation milestones with procurement milestones so there are no surprises on lead times; and (3) defines the GPU pool sizing and tranche mechanics (staging -> canary -> full).

Attached: MAP_v0.3.pdf (draft), GPU_Sizing_Sheet.xlsx (proposed mix).

Key asks from Redwood to close the loop this week:
- Can you confirm target production go-live date (you mentioned mid-Nov, please confirm exact week)?
- Procurement: what internal approval cutoffs do we need to hit to meet a Nov go-live (PO release date)?
- Sizing: please review the attached recommended pool mix (H100 x16 + A100 x8 for initial tranche) and tell us whether you prefer capacity skew or cost skew.

Proposed quick MAP checkpoints:
1) Eval sign-off (SLA & perf) — target 2026-09-15
2) PO & payment terms final — target 2026-09-30
3) Staging tranches delivered — target 2026-10-15
4) Canary + roll to prod — target 2026-11-15

We can shorten lead times if Helix commits to a 60% reserved baseline (we'll prioritize tranche scheduling). I'll loop in Ops (Priyom) and Onboard (Naomi) for acceptance criteria and cutovers.

Would love a confirmation of the PO timeline and any procurement blockers by EOD Thu (2026-08-12).

Thanks —

Daphne / team —

Thanks for the calendar — that gives us a clearer cut. Quick responses and a concrete alternative you can present to Finance:

1) Sizing options (summary pulled from GPU_Sizing_Sheet.xlsx):
  - Performance-first (recommended for low-latency): H100 x16 + A100 x8 -> estimated monthly token cost: $XXXk; throughput margin 35% above current target
  - Cost-first (Helix preference): A100 x28 -> estimated monthly token cost: ~$XXk (approx 22% lower), but tail latency 1.6x in stress tests
  - Hybrid tranche approach: Stage 1 (A100-heavy) for eval + canary, Stage 2 (add H100 tranche) before prod cutover. This minimizes initial spend and shortens procurement runway.

2) Acceptance window for private deployment: standard acceptance window we recommend is 10 business days after tranche delivery to complete integration tests + perf validation. We can compress to 5 business days with an agreed rollback plan and a short canary window (we'll document acceptance criteria in the MAP appendix).

3) SOC2 / compliance: Naomi (cc'd) — we maintain the SOC2 cert artifacts; we usually provide a SOC2 attestation PDF and evidence bundle (logs, retention policy, user access snapshots). Daphne — please let us know if you need more granular items (e.g., KMS inventory).

4) Lead-time acceleration option: if Helix confirms a 60% baseline reserved commit by Sep 15, we can priority-schedule the H100 tranche to ship in early Oct (instead of late Oct). That would align with your PO issuance window.

I've added cost/perf delta slides to the MAP_v0.3 appendix and updated tranche dates in the attached spreadsheet. Sharing HubSpot deal link for reference: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345

Next steps:
- Daphne: confirm whether you want the Hybrid tranche approach (recommended) or Cost-first now -> target reply by Thu EOD (08/12)
- Procurement: confirm PO approval cutoff items/questions (esp. KMS / SOC2 asks)

Marissa
